result.brief: 提出 Object-Uni 统一模型，将物体位姿作为理解与生成共享的显式几何变量，实现位姿感知、空间推理与位姿可控生成及物体级新视角合成。
result.reason: Unified understanding-generation model sharing an explicit object pose representation, with pose-conditioned generation and novel view synthesis; matches unified multimodal and world-model representation interests.
